task: Make SettingsTransferService.transfer_setting refuse subsystem-managed rows like the bulk transfer, keep ordinary rows moving, and add regression tests (EPMCDME-17677).

key_reasoning.reason: One method (SettingsTransferService.transfer_setting) in one service class; the rule _is_subsystem_managed already exists in the same class. Both PUT routers re-raise ExtendedHTTPException unchanged, so they need no edits.

Closest pattern is the bulk _select_candidates reserved-alias 422 (ExtendedHTTPException with message/details/help), which covers the same guard and the same alias set. The check must run before _validate_projects/_apply so nothing is written; the callers' transactional_session rolls back the preceding field update. The enumerated alias cases are covered by existing mock-based test templates (_setting, _FakeSession, bulk tests with the three representative aliases).
